name: CritPt
intro: CritPt（Complex Research using Integrated Thinking – Physics Test）评估模型解决未发表、研究级物理问题的能力，并非识别物理临界点。50 多位活跃物理研究者基于自身研究创建 71 个复合挑战并拆成 190 个检查点，覆盖 11 个现代物理学科。
org: Argonne National Laboratory, University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign
build_method: 50 多位活跃物理研究者基于未发表研究新建、自包含、抗搜索与抗猜测的挑战，拆为 2—4 个检查点并经迭代专家和同行复核
eval_feature: 两步生成自由解答与代码模板答案；私有服务器按数值容差、符号等价或 Python 隐藏用例自动判分
scale: 71 个挑战、190 个检查点；1 个公开样例、70 个私有答案测试挑战
build_method_en: 50+ active physics researchers create unpublished, self-contained, search-proof and guess-resistant challenges from their research, decompose each into 2-4 checkpoints, and iteratively expert- and peer-review them
eval_feature_en: Two-step free-form solution and code-template answer generation; private server auto-grading via numeric tolerances, symbolic equivalence or hidden Python tests
intro_en: CritPt (Complex Research using Integrated Thinking – Physics Test) evaluates models on unpublished research-level physics problems; it is not about detecting physical critical points. More than 50 active researchers create 71 composite challenges decomposed into 190 checkpoints across 11 modern physics disciplines.
scale_en: 71 challenges and 190 checkpoints; 1 public example and 70 test challenges with private answers
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2509.26574 v4, the official CritPt website, GitHub generation pipeline and Artificial Analysis grading interface. CritPt contains 71 composite challenges and 190 checkpoints created from unpublished work by 50+ active physics researchers across 30+ institutions and 11 disciplines. Each challenge is search-proof, guess-resistant and machine-verifiable, is decomposed into 2-4 checkpoints, and receives iterative expert and high-level peer review averaging more than 40 expert hours. One example is public while 70 test answers remain private. The official run generates a free-form solution and then a normalized code-template answer; complete 70-problem batches are graded by physics-specific numeric, symbolic or executable-function checks and headline accuracy is averaged over five runs.
